description: This file contains the implementation of the EfTaskRepository class, which interacts with the database to perform CRUD operations on TaskItem entities using Entity Framework Core. It implements the ITaskRepository interface and provides methods to get, add, update, and delete tasks.

classes.name: EfTaskRepository
classes.description: Implements ITaskRepository for database operations on TaskItem entities using Entity Framework Core.

methods.name: GetByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a task by its unique identifier asynchronously.

methods.name: GetAllAsync
methods.description: Retrieves all tasks ordered by creation date asynchronously.

methods.name: AddAsync
methods.description: Adds a new task to the database asynchronously.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing task in the database asynchronously.

methods.name: DeleteAsync
methods.description: Deletes a task from the database asynchronously.
